verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships a Dockerized FastAPI server and an MCP integration, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions issuing API keys or tokens, permission scopes, or least-privilege access controls. The only related item says there are "no forced API keys", which is an open-source access statement, not a credential-scoping capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
